Its extraordinary specification is highlighted by extensive exposed carbon fiber, lightweight forged wheels, massive carbon-ceramic brakes with red calipers, and the unmistakable Longtail aerodynamic treatment. The Amethyst Black finish is particularly captivating, appearing nearly black in lower light before revealing dramatic deep purple and violet undertones in direct sunlight. ** Both Sets of Seats Available Upon Request** Key Features:

675LT Longtail: Developed as a lighter, more powerful, and significantly more track-focused evolution of McLaren's Super Series platform, the 675LT revived McLaren's legendary Longtail philosophy with an uncompromising emphasis on performance, weight reduction, aerodynamics, and driver engagement.

Amethyst Black Exterior: An extraordinary McLaren finish with remarkable depth and character. Depending on lighting conditions, the paint can appear nearly black before revealing striking purple and violet tones in direct sunlight, giving this 675LT an unmistakable presence.

3,311 Miles: Exceptionally low mileage adds considerably to the desirability of this already special limited-production McLaren.

3.8L Twin-Turbocharged V8: The 675LT's twin-turbo V8 produces an incredible 666 horsepower, delivering explosive acceleration, immediate response, and breathtaking performance.

7-Speed Seamless Shift Gearbox: McLaren's lightning-fast dual-clutch transmission delivers rapid gear changes and helps translate the 675LT's extraordinary performance to the road.

Carbon-Fiber Longtail Aerodynamics: Extensive carbon-fiber aerodynamic components give the 675LT its unmistakable appearance while contributing to reduced weight, increased downforce, and enhanced high-speed stability.

Carbon-Fiber Side Intakes: The dramatic exposed carbon-fiber intake surrounds provide a striking contrast against the Fire Black paint while showcasing the lightweight construction found throughout the 675LT.

Carbon-Ceramic Brakes with Red Calipers: Massive carbon-ceramic brake rotors paired with vivid red McLaren brake calipers provide tremendous stopping capability while creating an unmistakable visual statement behind the lightweight wheels.

Lightweight Forged Wheels: Purpose-built lightweight wheels reduce unsprung mass and complement the 675LT's relentless focus on performance and weight reduction.

Carbon Black Interior: The purposeful dark cabin reinforces the 675LT's motorsport-inspired personality and provides an ideal contrast to the dramatic exterior specification.

Rear-Wheel Drive: The 675LT sends its tremendous power exclusively to the rear wheels, delivering the direct, engaging driving experience that helped establish the Longtail as one of McLaren's most celebrated modern performance cars.

Engine and Performance: Powered by McLaren's 3.8-liter twin-turbocharged V8 producing 666 horsepower, the 675LT was engineered around an uncompromising philosophy of increased power, reduced weight, improved aerodynamics, and greater driver involvement. Paired with a rapid-shifting 7-speed dual-clutch transmission and rear-wheel drive, the result is an intensely responsive supercar with extraordinary acceleration and a level of engagement that distinguishes the Longtail from the standard Super Series models.

With just 3,311 miles, its mesmerizing Fire Black finish, extensive carbon-fiber construction, and unmistakable Longtail design, this 2016 McLaren 675LT represents an exceptional opportunity to acquire one of the most significant performance-focused McLarens of its generation.

Finished in Torch Red over a Jet Black 3LZ interior, this 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 represents an extensively developed four-digit-horsepower C7 build combining a Magnuson 2650 supercharger system, heavily upgraded LT4 top end, comprehensive fueling and cooling systems, reinforced drivetrain, premium forged wheels, and extensive carbon fiber bodywork. From the factory, the Z06 features Chevrolet's supercharged 6.2-liter LT4 V8 paired in this example with the highly desirable 7-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching.

This example was exceptionally well equipped from the factory with the 3LZ Preferred Equipment Group, Z07 Performance Package, Competition Sport Bucket Seats, and Carbon Flash Painted Ground Effects Package. The 3LZ specification adds an extensively leather-trimmed cabin with a Sueded Microfiber-Wrapped Upper Interior Trim Package, while the Z07 package further enhances the Z06's track-focused chassis. Its original factory specification resulted in an MSRP of $110,445.

At the center of the build is a Magnuson 2650 supercharger upgraded with a THPSI billet 2650 lid and 103mm inlet snout. A Soler Performance 107mm throttle body and Roto-Fab 5-inch Big Gulp intake provide additional airflow, while a DSX 9.25-inch lower pulley, 80mm upper pulley, idler bracket system, and Gates Green belt complete the upgraded supercharger drive configuration.

The LT4 top end has received substantial development with Frankenstein Stage 2 ported cylinder heads, Frankenstein titanium valves and .700 springs, and a Cam Motion Stage 4 232/250 camshaft. Supporting valvetrain and engine hardware includes a CHE trunnion upgrade, ARP head studs, Katech Gen 5 LT4 AFM Delete Valley Cover, VVT phaser lock block, DSX aluminum valve covers, and ATI harmonic damper. Iridium spark plugs gapped to .028 and ACCEL Extreme 9000 plug wires provide additional ignition support.

Fuel delivery is comprehensively upgraded with a DSX low-side fuel system and AEM 400 pump feeding a DSX Atlas port injection system with dedicated plates and Injector Dynamics 1050cc injectors. A DSX flex-fuel system provides additional fueling versatility, while an Alky dual-injection methanol system with dual M15 nozzles and DSX dual widebands provide further support and monitoring for the high-output combination.

Cooling has received equally extensive attention. A DeWitts 70mm HP Series radiator, C7 Corvette 19-inch brushless electric fan, heat exchanger, and dedicated oil cooler provide substantially upgraded thermal management. A Cordes Performance expansion tank, 160-degree thermostat, and LaSilva aluminum thermostat cover complete the cooling package, while a dual Mighty Mouse C7 Z06 Wild catch can system provides upgraded crankcase ventilation.

Exhaust flow is handled through American Racing 2-inch full headers and X-pipe feeding a Corsa 2.75-inch Xtreme axle-back exhaust with quad Black tips. The combination provides a substantially more aggressive exhaust character while supporting the airflow requirements of the modified LT4.

The drivetrain has been reinforced with a McLeod 1200X dual-plate clutch kit to support the substantially increased output. An MGW short throw shifter and Black shift knob with White H-pattern provide a shorter and more direct interface with the 7-speed manual transmission.

The Corvette rides on premium 19-inch Signature SV309 forged three-piece wheels finished in Gloss Black. The forged wheel setup complements the Torch Red exterior and extensive exposed-carbon treatment while providing an appropriately high-end fitment for the level of the overall build.

Exterior modifications are extensive, highlighted by a Top Flight Automotive carbon fiber roof, R Style carbon fiber front splitter, carbon fiber fender vents, OEM Style carbon fiber side skirts, EOS carbon fiber rear quarter intake vents, carbon fiber spoiler with wicker bill, APR Style V2 carbon fiber rear diffuser, and carbon fiber quarter extensions. Dual Anderson Composites hood vents and an ACS Composite hood heat extractor kit further transform the hood while providing additional heat extraction for the high-output supercharged combination.

Inside, a custom carbon fiber and leather steering wheel creates a more performance-focused driver interface, while a P3 vent gauge provides additional vehicle monitoring. Carbon fiber wrapped interior trim carries the exterior carbon theme into the 3LZ cabin.

Professionally dyno tuned by THETA Motorsports, the completed combination produces an impressive 1,045 wheel horsepower and 808 lb-ft of torque.

With over $123,000 represented by parts and professional installation, this Z06 combines a Magnuson 2650 supercharger, extensively upgraded LT4 top end, comprehensive port-injection and flex-fuel system, methanol injection, extensive cooling, a McLeod dual-plate clutch, premium Signature three-piece wheels, and extensive carbon fiber bodywork into a serious four-digit-horsepower C7 build.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

This 2020 Chevrolet Corvette 2LT Coupe stands out with its striking Zeus Bronze Metallic exterior and refined Natural leather interior, offering a perfect blend of style and performance. With just over 45,000 miles, this used Corvette is equipped with premium features that elevate driving comfort and convenience, including Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a head-up display, heated seats, keyless entry, memory seats, navigation, a premium audio system, wireless phone charging, and a WiFi hotspot. Its bold 5 Open-Spoke Carbon Flash Painted Aluminum Wheels, measuring 19 x 8.5 inches in the front and 20 x 11 inches in the rear, enhance its sporty stance, while the Engine Appearance Package adds a touch of sophistication. This Corvette emphasizes security with rear parking sensors, a front dash camera recording footage for added safety, and a comprehensive anti-theft system featuring interior motion sensors and anti-tow alerts. The vehicle's braking system features painted calipers, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off ensures smooth stopping power. These features provide peace of mind and enhance the overall safety profile of this high-performance coupe.

The 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Entertainment and Technology Features

Inside, this Corvette is loaded with advanced entertainment options, including an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system with a touch screen display, real-time traffic navigation data, and HD radio. The audio experience is enhanced by a 12-speaker surround sound system, a dual subwoofer setup, and voice-operated radio and hands-free calling, ensuring connectivity and immersive sound. Compatible with the myChevrolet app and Connected Access, it allows seamless smartphone integration for added convenience and control, making every drive enjoyable and connected.

The 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Performance Features

Designed for thrill-seekers, this Corvette features a mid-mounted engine that delivers exceptional balance and power. It is equipped with a rear limited-slip differential and cylinder deactivation technology, optimizing traction and fuel efficiency. The sport-tuned suspension enhances handling and agility, allowing for precise steering and control on twisty roads or track days. These performance features make this Corvette a true icon of American muscle, ready to deliver unforgettable driving experiences.

Experience the thrill of driving a 2020 Toyota GR Supra 3.0 Premium Coupe, a striking vehicle that combines performance and luxury in a sleek Tungsten exterior with a sophisticated Black interior. This used model, with 44,166 miles, offers a dynamic 3.0-liter turbocharged six-cylinder engine producing 335 horsepower at 5,000 rpm and 365 lb-ft of torque at 1,600 rpm. Its rear-wheel-drive setup, paired with an 8-speed shiftable automatic transmission, ensures responsive handling and exhilarating acceleration. The GR Supra is equipped with modern technology features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a backup camera, and navigation with real-time traffic updates, all accessible through an 8.8-inch touchscreen and a premium JBL sound system with 12 speakers delivering 500 watts of crisp audio. Inside, you'll find heated seats, a head-up display, keyless entry, memory seats, push start, satellite radio readiness, wireless phone charging, and stylish interior accents, making every drive comfortable and connected.

This used vehicle is well-equipped with advanced safety and security features to provide peace of mind on the road. Brembo premium brakes deliver strong stopping power, complemented by dual front knee airbags and four-wheel ABS for enhanced safety. The GR Supra includes collision warning systems, electronic parking brake with auto-off, cornering brake control, anti-lock door locks with auto-locking, and emergency braking preparation, ensuring optimal security during every drive. Its painted brake calipers add a sporty touch, while the auto-locking power door locks and auto-off parking brake enhance convenience and control.

2020 Toyota GR Supra Safety and Security Features

This model features Brembo premium brakes for superior stopping performance, dual front knee airbags, and four-wheel ABS to maintain stability during emergency stops. Collision warning systems and emergency braking preparation help avoid accidents, while the electronic parking brake with auto-off simplifies parking. Power door locks include anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, providing security and ease of access. Cornering brake control enhances stability during turns, and painted brake calipers add a sporty aesthetic to this high-performance coupe.

2020 Toyota GR Supra Entertainment and Technology Features

The GR Supra boasts a premium JBL audio system with 12 speakers and 500 watts of power, delivering immersive sound. Its infotainment system features an 8.8-inch touchscreen with HD radio, real-time traffic navigation, and voice-operated controls for radio and hands-free phone calls. Surround sound amplifies the driving experience, making every journey enjoyable and connected.

2020 Toyota GR Supra Performance Features

Built for dynamic driving, the GR Supra comes with an active suspension, electronic suspension control, and driver-adjustable ride control to personalize handling. Auto start/stop technology improves efficiency, while the rear limited-slip differential enhances traction. The sport-tuned suspension ensures responsive, agile performance, making this coupe a true driver’s machine.

Its chassis is arranged for sharp road manners, and the suspension tuning is aimed at keeping the car settled during energetic driving. This example was built with automatic transmission, which provides straightforward operation in day-to-day use and on longer trips. The mechanical package is consistent with a performance coupe that was engineered for quick response and stable high-speed travel.

The audio system is upgraded to a premium unit, and the infotainment equipment includes navigation. A head-up display is also fitted, placing key driving information within the normal line of sight. Materials and switchgear are typical of the Corvette's era, with an emphasis on function and a low driving position rather than excess ornamentation.

Outside, the bodywork keeps the long, narrow proportions associated with this generation, and the lighting package includes xenon headlights. The rear cargo area is accessed with a hands-free liftgate, adding a convenience feature not usually found in a car of this type. The Corvette's profile remains low to the ground, with wide fenders and a long front section that reflect its mechanical layout. This vehicle combines the familiar Corvette structure with selected comfort and convenience equipment that broadens its everyday use without changing its underlying purpose.

This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them.   • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Safety and Security
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Night vision - Lift the veil of darkness. We've all been there, it's dark, and suddenly something appears out of nowhere in the road! With this safety feature, the night no longer holds unpleasant surprises. Working in combination with the headlights, night vision uses infrared technology to detect obstacles in the dark and show them on your display screen. Night vision makes for a safer drive between dusk and dawn.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. *COURTESY VEHICLE*

Vehicle Details
The 2027 INFINITI QX80 SPORT is an INFINITI of Boerne courtesy vehicle with fewer than 10,000 miles that has never been titled or registered to a retail owner. Its 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged V6 produces 450 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque through a 9-speed automatic transmission and standard INFINITI All-Mode 4WD, while SPORT-exclusive styling, 22-inch SPORT wheels, semi-aniline leather-appointed first- and second-row seating, and a 24-speaker Klipsch Reference Premiere audio system give this full-size luxury SUV a distinctive character. As a low-mileage dealer courtesy vehicle, it offers a nearly new INFINITI ownership experience at a significant discount from the original MSRP.
This QX80 SPORT is sold as INFINITI Certified with 6-year/75,000-mile limited warranty coverage from the original in-service date, plus INFINITI Certified benefits. It also receives the complimentary Synergy Commitment from INFINITI of Boerne, providing additional powertrain protection through 7 years/100,000 total odometer miles from the original in-service date. The two forms of coverage are distinct: the INFINITI Certified limited warranty remains 6 years/75,000 miles from the original in-service date, while the Synergy Commitment provides complimentary powertrain protection through the 7-year/100,000-mile point from that same original in-service date.
Courtesy vehicles occupy an appealing position for luxury buyers because their value is created by how they have been used and priced. This QX80 served INFINITI of Boerne as a dealer courtesy vehicle for service loaner or executive transportation duty, remained under dealership care, and has been maintained and regularly inspected by factory-trained technicians. It has never had a retail owner, yet its prior dealership use allows it to be offered at a meaningful reduction from its original MSRP. For a buyer who values current-generation engineering and amenities but would rather avoid paying full new-vehicle pricing, that combination can make considerable sense.
The SPORT trim gives the QX80 a more assertive visual identity without trying to turn a three-row luxury SUV into something it is not. A unique grille and front bumper, dark chrome accents, black roof rails, SPORT badging, and distinctive 22-inch wheels provide a more athletic presentation. Inside, semi-aniline leather-appointed first- and second-row seating, personalized ambient lighting, open-pore ash wood trim, and SPORT-specific details create an environment that feels tailored rather than simply decorated. The design works particularly well for an executive or family buyer who wants the space of a full-size SUV without sacrificing a strong sense of occasion.
Its twin-turbocharged V6 is central to that experience. The 450-horsepower engine's 516 lb-ft of torque provides the low- and midrange response that matters when moving a vehicle of this size, whether merging onto I-10 or passing at highway speeds. The 9-speed automatic transmission gives the engine a broad range of ratios to work with, while All-Mode 4WD can vary power distribution to help the QX80 respond to changing road conditions. Dynamic Digital Suspension continually manages body movement and vibration, helping reconcile the QX80's substantial dimensions with the controlled ride expected of a flagship luxury SUV.
The cabin takes an equally thoughtful approach to long-distance comfort. Heated and ventilated first- and second-row seating helps manage Texas temperature swings, while massaging front seats can reduce fatigue on longer drives. The QX80 SPORT's Advanced Climate Control system incorporates an air purifier and Biometric Cooling, technology designed to monitor passenger conditions and automatically make climate adjustments for second-row occupants. These are features whose value becomes clearer over hours behind the wheel, particularly on a Hill Country weekend or a long family trip.
Technology is integrated around the same principle of reducing effort. The 24-speaker Klipsch Reference Premiere system uses Individual Audio headrest speakers to create a more focused listening experience for front occupants, while the QX80's digital displays place navigation, vehicle information, entertainment, and other functions within an expansive modern interface. Invisible Hood View and Front Wide View provide additional perspectives around this large SUV, making tight parking spaces, curbs, and crowded approaches easier to judge from the driver's seat.
Practicality remains fundamental to the QX80. Three-row seating gives families and frequent travelers genuine passenger flexibility, while the full-size architecture provides the cargo versatility expected of a flagship SUV. When properly equipped, the QX80 can tow up to 8,500 pounds, adding meaningful capability for owners who travel with a boat or trailer. Driver-assistance technology, including ProPILOT Assist, is designed to reduce workload during highway travel while keeping the driver engaged and responsible for vehicle operation.
Because this QX80 SPORT has never been titled or registered to a retail owner, it may qualify for special leasing programs for qualified customers. INFINITI of Boerne can explain available leasing options alongside a traditional purchase.
INFINITI of Boerne is a 2026 J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence, the first INFINITI retailer in Texas to earn it, a Five-time INFINITI Award of Excellence recipient, and a Five-time CARFAX Top Rated Dealer. Located directly on Interstate 10 north of San Antonio, the dealership also offers complimentary Texas home delivery, making this QX80 SPORT accessible to luxury buyers throughout Greater San Antonio and the Hill Country.
Contact INFINITI of Boerne to experience this 2027 QX80 SPORT and determine whether this low-mileage courtesy vehicle fits your next chapter of ownership.

Rather than having a previous retail owner, it has served INFINITI of Boerne as a dealer courtesy vehicle for service-loaner or executive-transportation duty. Throughout that service it has been maintained and regularly inspected by INFINITI of Boerne's factory-trained technicians. Its 22-inch wheels give the full-size proportions a more substantial stance, while the cabin moves beyond the fundamentals with leather-appointed first- and second-row seating. Both of those rows are heated and ventilated, an especially useful combination in Texas, where ventilation can matter as much as heating depending on the season. The standard seven-passenger configuration uses second-row captain's chairs, creating a comfortable separation between passengers while preserving convenient access to the power-folding third row.
The QX80's twin-turbocharged V6 is engineered around effortless torque rather than simply producing an impressive specification. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. Luxury. Presence. Technology. Space. Confidence.

Make an unmistakable entrance in the 2023 Cadillac Escalade ESV Premium, a full-size luxury SUV that combines commanding road presence with sophisticated design, premium comfort, advanced technology, and exceptional passenger and cargo capacity. With its extended ESV body, bold Cadillac styling, and upscale interior, the Escalade ESV is designed for drivers who expect more from a luxury SUV.

Commanding Cadillac Design

The Escalade ESV immediately establishes itself as a premium full-size SUV with its unmistakable Cadillac design. Its imposing proportions, distinctive front grille, signature LED lighting, sculpted bodywork, and sophisticated detailing create an exterior presence that is difficult to overlook.

The extended ESV configuration adds an impressive amount of usable space while maintaining the Escalade's upscale appearance and road presence. Whether you're arriving at a business meeting on the Las Vegas Strip, traveling throughout Henderson and Summerlin, or taking the family on a long-distance road trip, the Escalade ESV delivers the stature and versatility expected from a flagship luxury SUV.

Premium Luxury Interior

Step inside and the Escalade ESV transitions from commanding exterior presence to a sophisticated luxury environment designed around comfort, connectivity, and convenience.

Cadillac's advanced curved OLED display brings a dramatic high-tech centerpiece to the cabin, while premium materials, carefully designed controls, and a spacious passenger compartment create an environment suited for both daily driving and extended travel.

The Escalade ESV's three-row configuration makes it particularly appealing to luxury SUV shoppers who need genuine passenger capacity without sacrificing premium appointments. With generous interior volume and substantial cargo flexibility, it is equally at home transporting passengers, luggage, business equipment, or everything required for a weekend away.

Advanced Technology

Technology is one of the defining characteristics of the modern Escalade. The 2023 model incorporates Cadillac's expansive OLED display technology, sophisticated infotainment functionality, smartphone connectivity, navigation, and premium AKG audio technology.

For luxury SUV buyers searching for a vehicle that combines premium comfort with cutting-edge automotive technology, the Escalade ESV remains an especially compelling choice.

Performance & Capability

The Escalade ESV provides the substantial power and confident road manners expected from a full-size Cadillac luxury SUV. The 2023 model was offered with Cadillac's powerful V8 engine and a 10-speed automatic transmission, with four-wheel drive available depending on configuration.

Its substantial size, long-wheelbase ESV design, and available towing capability also make it an attractive option for drivers who want their luxury SUV to provide more than simply a premium commuting experience.

A Luxury SUV Built for Southern Nevada

The 2023 Cadillac Escalade ESV Premium is particularly well suited to the lifestyle of Southern Nevada. Its expansive interior is ideal for family transportation, executive travel, airport trips, weekend excursions, and long-distance drives throughout Nevada, California, Arizona, and beyond.

description: Crisp Crystal White Tricoat and the blacked-out Onyx Package give this used 2021 Cadillac Escalade ESV Sport 4WD a sharp, custom presence. The extended-length ESV backs up the look with three spacious rows and extra cargo room. Under the hood, a 6.2L V8 makes 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque through a 10-speed automatic and four-wheel drive, with an electronic limited-slip differential for sure-footed traction. The Driver Assist Tech Package adds Air Ride Adaptive Suspension for a composed, cushioned ride, plus Adaptive Cruise Control, Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, and Reverse Automatic Braking. It also brings soft-closing front and rear doors and illuminating front and rear sill plates. Inside, Brandy full leather seats with faceted quilting and Very Dark Atmosphere accents surround you in rich color. The front seats are heated and ventilated, the rear seats are heated, and an air ionizer helps keep the cabin fresh. A power panoramic tilt-sliding sunroof brightens all three rows. The AKG Studio 19-speaker audio system, the Rear Seat Entertainment System, and wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto keep everyone entertained. A reconfigurable full-color head-up display and the Rear Camera Mirror with washer keep your view clear. Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, and automatic seat belt tightening add confidence. For towing, it has an integrated trailer brake controller, Hitch Guidance with Hitch View, Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert, and the in-vehicle trailering app. A theft-deterrent alarm system works with glass-breakage, vehicle-inclination, and interior-movement sensors, plus door lock and latch shields. Outside, the Onyx Package's gloss black Escalade nameplate and monochrome Cadillac emblems join 22-inch 12-spoke gloss black alloy wheels and body-color door handles. Puddle lamps with the Cadillac crest and power-retractable assist steps complete the look. If you're shopping for a used Cadillac Escalade ESV or a full-size luxury SUV for sale in Norman or the Oklahoma City area, this ESV Sport is ready for a test drive. To speak with a sales consultant or schedule a test drive, give us a call at 405-329-2222. You can also visit our showroom in person at 6400 N Interstate Dr, Norman, OK 73072 to explore our current lineup and take a test drive.
